subject: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, we need a clean consolidated forecast and concise account-level snapshots for the exec pipeline review on Monday. Goals: one slide per named account (ask/close plan, next 30/90 day milestones, top risks) and a single consolidated forecast table we can drop into the deck.

Immediate asks (can we treat this as the single source of truth?):
- Marissa: please produce the consolidated forecast (by ARR, close-probability weighted) and attach the working sheet. Use the latest booking dates and pull in pipeline stages with probabilities.
- Laura: fill in account snapshots for the six focus accounts (Acme, Connex, Zephyr, Altara, Beacon Health, NovaRetail). Keep each snapshot to 3 bullets + one risk line.
- Rishi: add any known deal-level blockers or procurement timelines, and confirm whether we should escalate Acme procurement this week.

Deliverable deadlines: first-pass by EOD today (Aug 22) so I can assemble slides Saturday morning and share draft with Vivek for Sunday review. If you have any material you don't want in the public deck, mark it PRIVATE in the filename.

Attachments: Account snapshot template attached (acct-snapshots-Acme-2026-08.xlsx).

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review

Thanks Steph — quick status update:

- Consolidated forecast: preliminary stitch complete (attached: forecast-stitch-2026-08.pdf). At a glance: total weighted ARR for the six focus accounts is $3.1M (current quarter), best-case $4.2M. I've included stage-level breakouts and probability assumptions in the sheet.
- Acme: sales exec update included in their snapshot (attached row in the workbook). Sarah has verbally confirmed a procurement window in late Sep; we don't have their signed SOW yet.
- Slides: I started slide placeholders and added a tab for slide-owner assignments.

Open items:
1) Need Laura's account bullets for Acme to finalize the close plan.
2) Rishi — can you confirm procurement details so I can set the close probability in the model?

I'm attaching the stitch and the draft account snapshot workbook. I'll push an updated workbook by 5pm after Laura's inputs.

Attachments: forecast-stitch-2026-08.pdf; acct-snapshots-Acme-2026-08.xlsx

—Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review

Marissa — uploaded my Acme snapshot into the workbook (tab: Acme). Key bullets for the exec slide:

- Opportunity: 3.6M ARR for Redwood inference across multi-product deployment (Hosted + Dedicated).
- Close plan: Procurement + legal review in Aug -> PO by late Sep. We plan a final technical exec demo next Wed (Aug 28) to clear remaining infra/security questions.
- Ask: propose 20% discount off list for committed 12-month Reserved capacity to secure procurement cadence; commercial to own final terms.
- Risk: procurement requires a SOC2 attestation and KMS integration note; engineering availability for a short POC may be a gating factor.

Rishi — I flagged procurement timelines in the comments and linked the SOC2 compliance packet in Confluence (Confluence: Sales/Acme/Account-Snapshot).

Also: small correction to the consolidated forecast — I adjusted the probability on Connex (was 40% -> now 60%) based on their positive follow-up this morning. Please refresh the weighted numbers in the master sheet.

Laura Bennett
Account Director
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review

Thanks Laura — I refreshed the stitch and attached the updated forecast (forecast-stitch-2026-08.pdf). Summary table now reflects Laura's Connex probability change and includes separate columns for procurement ETA and legal review status.

Slide assignments (proposal):
- Acme slide: Laura (narrative) + Marissa (commercial summary)
- Connex slide: Marissa
- Zephyr + Altara + Beacon + NovaRetail: split across Rishi & me (I'll own Zephyr + NovaRetail; Rishi take Altara + Beacon)

Next steps:
- Laura & Rishi: final snapshot bullets by EOD today.
- Stephanie: if you're ok with the slide-owner plan, I'll populate the deck and share for review Saturday morning.

Attachments: forecast-stitch-2026-08.pdf; exec-slide-assignments-2026-08.pptx

—Marissa
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec pipeline prep: consolidated forecast + account snapshots for leadership review

Team + Sarah — thanks for the fast turnaround. Marissa, Laura, Rishi: I reviewed the consolidated forecast and the account snapshots this afternoon. The combined doc reads cleanly and I've pulled a 1-page Acme snapshot we can share with Sarah ahead of the demo.

Sarah — looping you in to confirm the technical demo on Aug 28 at 11am PT (we're targeting 45 mins + 15 for procurement questions). Agenda: brief architecture walkthrough (15m), demo of Dedicated deployment at scale (20m), procurement/next steps (15m). If procurement needs an additional attendee from Redwood, indicate who and we'll invite them.

Public materials: attached is the 1-page Acme snapshot (acct-snapshots-Acme-2026-08.xlsx excerpt) and a copy of the consolidated forecast for your internal planning. If there's anything you don't want included in the public-facing packet, tell us and we'll remove it.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acct-snapshots-Acme-2026-08.xlsx (excerpt), forecast-stitch-2026-08.pdf
